decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that fully records LED technology and selection of suitable LEDs compatible with the existing setup.
Selecting compatible LEDs for the BOM does not itself change the CAD deliverable, motor accommodation, or CAD-retention requirements.
The source approves a compatible LED component but does not establish a new wiring-plan attribute or alter the existing wiring-documentation requirement.
LED component selection does not change matcha mixing, frothing, whisk, or high-speed performance requirements.
The selected accent LEDs are not identified as food-contact components and do not change the food-safe contact-material standard.
The LED selection does not alter spout geometry, material, orientation, appearance, or pouring direction.
The source approves LEDs but does not specify or change the machine, accent, or support-base colors.
Lighting around the bowls does not change their capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraint.
The source cautions against constructing another base before creative alignment but does not change the accepted enclosure form factor.
The LED component decision does not change placard wording, placement, duplication, or viewing orientation.
Accent-light selection has no effect on splash targets, guards, or high-speed splash mitigation.
The source requires LEDs compatible with the setup but does not change access or serviceability requirements for internal components.
